represents: Live Finviz homepage market-day prose (prior cash close + overnight / weekend news). Not quote-page ticker blurbs.
headline: Weekend Brief: US markets enter the week with easing Fed hike expectations as AI optimism and Middle East energy risks frame a light data calendar ahead of big-box retail earnings
raw_text:
- Weekend brought little stock-specific US corporate news, with no major M&A, guidance changes, or analyst calls to drive equity sentiment
- Recent cooler CPI and PPI readings have led markets to dial back odds of a September Fed rate hike even as bonds remain pressured by rising global yields
- AI-driven enthusiasm continues to underpin equity sentiment, with open-weight AI developments viewed as unlikely to significantly weaken demand for core infrastructure providers
- Persistent Middle East tensions, including stalled Iran talks and potential Hormuz shipping disruption, are supporting Gulf equity markets and elevating energy price and US inflation risks
- India’s move to increase cooking gas output targets adds to upside pressure risks for global energy markets
- Weekend media coverage from Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, and Reuters stressed that apparent equity-market calm belies rapid shifts in investor positioning
- Moves in Asian and European markets on rates, oil (@CL), and AI themes are expected to set the early tone for US trading on Monday
- Traders head into Monday watching a light US data slate featuring the NY Empire State Manufacturing Index and NAHB Housing Market Index
- Later in the week, big-box retail earnings including Walmart (WMT) are in focus for new signals on US consumer health
